body.p: Claims 1-20 are pending and subject to a restriction and/or election requirement. See Sec.

(9) of the Office Action Summary. In this Reply, Applicant provides a complete response to the election requirement put forth in the Office Action. In addition, claims 1-3, 5, 7, 9, 10, 12-14, and 16-19 have been amended for clarity. The amendments do not add new matter. Upon entry of this Reply, claims 1-20 will remain pending, with claims 1-4 elected for prosecution of their merits and claims 5-20 being withdrawn. Reconsideration of the present application is respectfully requested in light of the following comments.

The Office Action asserts that the pending claims are directed to the following three species, and requires election of a single species, or single grouping of patentably indistinct species, among the following species for prosecution on the merits:
Species A: Fig. lA Species B: Fig. 3A.
Applicant elects, without traverse, Species C, encompassing claims 1-4, for prosecution on the merits.
This paper constitutes a complete response to the election requirement put forth in the Office Action.

Other than any fees submitted herewith, Applicant believes no further fees are due. However, if a fee is due, please charge our Deposit Account Number 01-2300, under number 043505.01359 from which the undersigned is authorized to draw.
If this communication is filed after the shortened statutory time period had elapsed and no separate Petition is enclosed, Applicant(s) hereby petition, under 37 C.F.R. § 1.136(a), to extend

the time for filing a response to the outstanding Office Action by the number of months necessary to avoid abandonment under 37 C.F.R. § 1.135. Please charge any such fee under 37 C.F.R. § 1.17 to Deposit Account No. 01-2300.
